deadline.value: Applications are due December 8, 2026 at 11:59pm EST.
deadline.quote: Submitted applications are due by 11:59pm EST on December 8th.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but strongly recommended for physical chemistry (especially theory); you are not penalized without them.
gre_general.quote: GRE general and subject scores are not required, but they are strongly recommended if you are applying to the physical chemistry division

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry subject test is not required, but strongly recommended for physical chemistry (especially theory).
gre_subject.quote: GRE general and subject scores are not required, but they are strongly recommended if you are applying to the physical chemistry division

english_waiver.value: TOEFL is required for non-native speakers even with prior study in the US or another English-speaking country; the FAQ says most admits have iBT above 100 and a Speaking score of at least 20 is required. IELTS is accepted.
english_waiver.quote: We require TOEFL scores regardless of undergraduate and graduate work already completed in the United States or another English speaking country.

also.quote: The majority of admitted students have total iBT scores above 100
We will accept IELTS scores in place of the TOEFL.

supervisor.value: Apply to the department, not a group; you pick an advisor during the fall of the first year.
supervisor.quote: There is no need to contact Penn Chemistry professors during the application process. | The research advisor selection process takes place during the Fall of the first year.

funding.value: All accepted PhD students get tuition, health insurance and a monthly stipend for all 5 years, regardless of citizenship.
funding.quote: provides full support (tuition, health insurance, and a monthly stipend) to all accepted graduate students for all 5 years of study.

entry_route.value: The pages do not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: The FAQ still says materials are due December 1; the admissions page and SAS calendar say December 8. No TOEFL minimum is stated as a rule (iBT above 100 is only what most admits have).
